sourceNotes: LOCATION remains id=null plus BoardPosition. Input uses the existing 84-unit grid footprint, camera and own-side inversion; marker is at the addressed cell center. Because this domain has no container ID, rows interleave by stable inviter/recipient side (2*logicalRow + side), including signed camera margins. Both viewers decode the same side; no screen pixels or card/container identity are stored as a location.

TableRuntimeHooks.ping now takes EventPingIntent; pingReference carries the displayed boundary/version. Only owned TableScreen/TableScene callers used the old signature. Press captures explicit operation/reference before later scene updates; marker removal keeps the original recorded reference. Shared reducer still derives recording group and ordinal. No TableGestureCoordinator or link engine change.

Production callback fences foreground, connected game and original play; normal annotations use LobbyController.annotate/GameSession, deliberate armed continuation uses LobbyController.gameplay/TableHistoryController lowering. The existing coordinator retains immediate mode taps and pan/pinch/rectangle/hold arbitration. Mode resets on a derived group change; drawing/removal uses only current-group active records and visible scene endpoints. Accessible field actions choose visible empty cells; marker semantics expose ordinal and Unping.
